title: Mexican Borek
description: A twist on traditional Mexican dishes, this recipe combines crispy borek pastry with savory turkey and cheese.
instructions: Roll out the Turkish borek dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
In a pan, sauté the diced onion and turkey breast until browned.
Add cumin and chili powder to the pan and stir.
Roll the borek dough into a large rectangle.
Place the turkey mixture in the center of the dough, leaving a 1 inch border.
Sprinkle shredded cheese over the turkey mixture.
Fold the dough over the filling and press edges to seal.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Cut into triangles and serve with salsa.
